Integration Consultant

Datadog Munich, Bavaria, Germany Apply on company website

We are seeking an experienced Enterprise Integration Consultant to join our Solutions and Customer Engineering team in Munich, Germany.

In this role, you will partner with key enterprise clients to architect, build, and optimize scalable integration pipelines using MuleSoft, Boomi, Salesforce, and modern cloud iPaaS architectures. You will serve as the technical authority on API-led connectivity, DataWeave transformations, and hybrid cloud implementations.

Responsibilities include leading technical discovery, architecting customer solutions, driving customer onboarding and adoption, and collaborating with forward-deployed engineering teams. Fluent English communication is required. German language is optional.
